name: Delfin III

seo.title: Delfin III Amazon Cruise, Peru | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Delfin III, Delfin Amazon Cruises' largest boat: 22 suites, up to 43 guests, built in Iquitos. 3 or 4 nights from Nauta into Pacaya-Samiria.

tagline: Built in the Iquitos docks, with a bathtub in the bow.
answer: Delfin III is the largest boat of Delfín Amazon Cruises, a Relais & Châteaux member in Peru. She has 22 suites in four categories for up to 43 guests and sails three or four nights round trip from Nauta into the Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve, with high and low water routes. Children 7 and over sail.
facts: 22 in four categories (Owner's, Corner, Upper, Suite)
In the Iquitos docks by local artisans
Lounge, gym, dining room, sun deck and pool, boutique, spa
overview: Delfin III is the newest and largest of the Delfín fleet, built in Iquitos by local artisans. Delfín says it has led trips into Pacaya-Samiria for nearly two decades and is a Relais & Châteaux member.

The Owner's Suite fills the bow: about 600 sq ft with 180-degree windows, a lounge and a soaking tub. Corner Suites on the main deck are about 253 sq ft with 90-degree windows and include a 30-minute spa treatment and laundry. Upper Suites on the second deck and Suites on the main deck are about 237 sq ft.
why: Delfín publishes full rates for 2026 and 2027 by suite, and builds its boats in Iquitos. Delfin III includes juices, soft drinks, select alcohol, domestic beer and house wine at meals.

pricesNote: Per person sharing, USD, as published by Delfín Amazon Cruises. Only the lowest published fare is shown; the fare for each suite is confirmed when you ask. Single supplement: 50% on Suites and Upper Suites, 75% on Owner's and Corner Suites. Deposit US$750 per person; balance 90 days before sailing.
inclusions: All meals on board (box lunch and dinner on arrival day, breakfast and box lunch on departure day)

Transfers between Iquitos airport and Nauta on the recommended LATAM flights
Entrance fee to the Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve
Juices, soft drinks, coffee, tea, water, select alcoholic drinks and domestic beer; house wine with lunch and dinner
exclusions: Gratuities (suggested US$250 for 3 nights, US$320 for 4, US$500 for 7)
Additional bar, minibar and boutique purchases
children: Minimum age 7. Children 11 and under get 20% off the adult rate.
